name: z-ai/glm-5.2
description: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's open-weight flagship text model released in June 2026 for long-horizon tasks, and the first GLM model to deliver that capability on a usable 1M-token context. Z.ai positions it for project-scale software engineering, deep debugging and full development workflows from requirements to deployable products, with steadier long-task execution and closer adherence to engineering standards. GLM-5.3 builds on the same base model with further post-training for coding.
